scope: One original actor RIGHT lowerarm+hand component only. No other parts, keys, animation, in-betweens, runtime/integration, atlas or loop approval.
gate: Wait for parent final upperarm source-fit/partial review, then obtain a separate finite one-call authorization. This file is not authorization.

component.ownership: Actor RIGHT forearm, wrist and attached relaxed hand; viewer-left in front-facing South; anatomical RIGHT thumb on viewer-right/body-interior edge.

local_bone_plane.estimate_note: Approximate guide targets visually estimated from canonical South, not measured anatomy. Actual source endpoints and hand landmarks remain unknown until raw exists.

proximal_overlap.description: A small bare-skin overlap goes beneath the existing ivory upper-arm sleeve and its already rolled cuff. Keep lower part behind the sleeve at proximal seam; no second visible rolled cuff or fabric band.

component.rest_pose: Neutral unbent forearm and naturally relaxed hand with gently curled fingers; no grip or clenched fist.
component.calibration: After raw exists, inspect natural landmarks with evidence and uncertainty; one uniform raw-to-bone-rest calibration maps elbow/wrist to [0,0]/[0,180]. No guide-derived fake coordinates, anisotropic source calibration, crop, alpha cleanup, tracing, source edit or per-frame fit. Fixed South camera projection remains in v4 baker.

tooling.note: Internal bone plane is unforeshortened; camera projection is applied once after uniform static calibration.

future_inputs_exact_order_if_authorized.role: Canonical South identity, relaxed hand shape, actor RIGHT thumb ownership, neutral direction and body scale.
Established painterly skin/material rendering, palette and northwest light only; South controls direction and anatomy.
Actual calibrated core+upper-sleeve proposal preview for ivory cuff opening and hidden forearm overlap only. PROPOSAL_ONLY, not accepted motion/key/sidecar.
MODEL_ONLY geometry for actor RIGHT forearm+hand silhouette and local bone/wrist/hand extents only; no appearance authority.

geometry_guide.note: Geometry-only guide, not final art/style authority.

review_constraints: The two-part preview is a calibration proposal and cloth-opening reference only, not accepted movement or whole-character key art.
Upper sleeve owns the visible ivory cuff; the lowerarm starts hidden under it and shows skin below without a duplicated cuff.
No raw endpoints or grip/hand landmark locations are asserted before the original exists.
After any separately authorized call, preserve exact raw and report actual measured endpoints/widths with uncertainty before a sidecar is sealed.

approval_state.part acceptance: pending actual raw and source inspection
